summary: Tested enterprise tables and drivers per project, project_admin (pmburger) isolation, a non-enterprise tenant and the enterprise admin Settings tabs, on the backend (pytest, 17 tests: 11 pass, 6 fail) and the UI (Playwright). TABLES fully PASS. Project bar shown; switching project resets the branch select to that project's first branch and shows only its branches/tables; POST saves project_id=burger; X-Project-Id filtering works; mismatched project_id gives 400; project admin PUT on another project's table gives 404. DRIVERS backend FAILS. routes/drivers_routes.py (drivers_router is included in server.py ~L18480, BEFORE app.include_router(api_router)) SHADOWS the new GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/drivers in server.py (L16102-16335). None of the new driver logic runs. PROJECT ADMIN: login, /auth/me role=project_admin, /users and /projects scoped, payment-settings forced to his project, printer/table/owner-admin guards all PASS. Settings tabs are correct, and the project bar shows only his project and cannot be switched. FAILS: the project admin cannot create any user (403), and he can move a user of his project into another project's branch. NON-ENTERPRISE tenant: no project bar or badges on Tables/Delivery, create works. Admin Settings regression: all 17 tabs visible.

critical.issue: ROOT CAUSE: routes/drivers_routes.py defines the same paths and its router is included before api_router, so it wins and the server.py implementations are dead code. As a result: (a) POST ignores the branch's project and uses X-Project-Id or the tenant default; in the all-projects view a driver created on burger branch الكرادة is saved with project_id=None (verified in DB). (b) GET ?project_id=X filters strictly on project_id, so legacy drivers with no project but a branch in X are missing. (c) PUT with a branch of another project + mismatching project_id returns 200 'تم تعديل السائق' instead of 400. (d) The project admin can PUT a driver of another project (200). (e) DriverResponse has no project_id field, so the API never returns project_id; frontend badges only work through the branch fallback. (f) DELETE /drivers/{id} in drivers_routes has no tenant/project check at all (find_one by id only), so it can delete across tenants.

create_user allows only ADMIN/GENERAL_MANAGER/SUPER_ADMIN. The project admin is mapped to MANAGER, so every create returns 403 'إنشاء الحسابات متاح للمالك فقط'. The is_project_admin forcing branch (L5084) is unreachable, and the project admin cannot add users to his project. The role=admin→403 check passes, but only because of this blanket 403.

Project escape. update_user pops project_id for the project admin but then derives project_id from branch_id (L4787). Sending {branch_id: <shawarma branch>} moved a burger user to project_id=shawarma (200). Validate that branch_id belongs to current_user.project_id for the project admin.

minor.issue: Returns 403 instead of 404, because the admin-role check runs before any _project_admin_guard. Still denied; the spec expected 404.
No _project_admin_guard: the project admin can change the status of another project's table.
For the project admin the query includes all drivers with project_id None/missing, including drivers whose branch belongs to another project.

ui_bugs.issue: handleCreateDriver sends {...formData, branch_id: selectedBranch}. The branch the user picks inside the dialog's Select is always overridden by the header branch.

integration_issues.flow: Create driver in the all-projects view
integration_issues.issue: The driver is saved with project_id=None (backend shadowing). The card badge still shows the project only because of the branch fallback.

issues: The dropdown is enabled and lists 'كل المشاريع' plus his project; picking does nothing (selectProject is a no-op). Better to disable or hide the select for restricted users.
The empty wrapper div page-project-bar-wrap (pt-4) still renders, adding extra top spacing.
The branch <select> truncates long branch names (e.g. 'البرغر الملكي - المنصور'). Neither header branch select has a data-testid.

action_items: Remove or merge the duplicate driver CRUD in routes/drivers_routes.py, or move the new logic there: branch-derived project_id with validation (400 on mismatch), the legacy branch fallback in GET ?project_id, project admin guards, project_id in DriverResponse, and a tenant check on DELETE
Allow is_project_admin in POST /api/users (it is blocked by the role whitelist at L5063)
In PUT /api/users for the project admin, reject a branch_id outside his project
Add _project_admin_guard to PUT /tables/{id}/status; consider returning 404 before the owner-admin 403 in DELETE /users
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate route definitions across server.py and routes/*.py silently shadow each other depending on include order; check for other duplicated paths
server.py is >18k lines; the new enterprise helpers belong in routes/shared.py
seed_data_creation: Created a temp tenant t330ne613d6 (tier changed to customer) plus TEST330_ drivers/tables/users/printers; all cleaned up. pmburger kept.

Branch selects on /tables and /delivery: use the 'header select' locator. The project bar select is [data-testid=settings-project-select]. New super-admin tenants default to trial with enterprise_enabled=True; PUT /api/super-admin/tenants/{id} {account_tier:'customer'} disables it. rca of the issue: Drivers: app.include_router(drivers_router, prefix='/api') runs before app.include_router(api_router). FastAPI matches the first registered route, so the old drivers_routes handlers serve /api/drivers. PA user create: the role whitelist runs before the enterprise PA logic, and get_current_user maps project_admin→manager, which is not in the whitelist.
